description.invocation: One accumulated GPT-2 training step starting from the fixed initial weights, exactly the step() closure at gpt2_ddp_training.py:102-105 with the preceding reset() (load_state_dict of the saved initial weights, gpt2_ddp_training.py:99-100): accumulate() over the 4 pre-generated per-rank micro-batches (micro_batch=1, sequence_length=128, first 3 micro-batches under model.no_sync(), final micro-batch triggers the DDP gradient all-reduce), one SGD(lr=0.001, momentum=0.0, weight_decay=0.0, foreach=False) optimizer.step(), then torch.cuda.synchronize(). Inputs already live on the rank's CUDA device; each repeated invocation begins from the same initial weights.

source.aggregation: per-rank sum of NCCL kernel durations in separately profiled invocations, max across the 2 ranks, median over the 3 profiled repetitions (gpt2_ddp_training.py:156-157)

notes: Measured invocation from intent.json: torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=2 gpt2_ddp_training.py --output /tmp/original-ddp --profile (README.md:37 documents the equivalent python -m torch.distributed.run form).

Unit of work repeated by adapter.run() is one accumulated training step (reset + accumulate + SGD update + CUDA sync). The rest is benchmark-harness measurement infrastructure: warmup(2) and clean repeats(5) with per-repeat weight reset; rank-0 serial reference construction over the same global batch; finite-loss assertion, global-batch gradient check, +1-corruption negative control, exact cross-rank replica check and post-step parameter check; the 3 separately profiled diagnostic iterations; the extra one-off allreduce-hook bucket inventory run; JSON/trace report writing.

Objective semantics (workloads.json gpt2_ddp_training.communication_metric_caveat): sum of device NCCL kernel durations per rank, then maximum across ranks, median over 3 profiled repeats; includes device waiting and is not wire time, exposed communication or a critical-path lower bound. It maps to the installed torch_communication collector field communication_kernel_sum_ms with rank_aggregation=max.

Constraint semantics: step_ms is the clean (unprofiled) full accumulated-step wall time, max across ranks (gpt2_ddp_training.py:150), and must stay <= 1.05x baseline (workloads.json goals[1].constraints.step_ms_max_baseline_ratio, README.md:48). It is full-request step time, not a cached-only or partial variant.

Discrete exact comparisons: every parameter gradient must be bitwise identical across ranks (torch.testing.assert_close with atol=0.0, rtol=0.0 against a rank-0 broadcast replica, gpt2_ddp_training.py:81-86), and the validator's negative control must reject a +1 corruption of reference gradients (common.py:79-84).

Numerical policy preserved: FP32 weights and inputs, TF32 disabled for matmul and cudnn, float32_matmul_precision 'highest', dropout 0 (resid/attn/embd), use_cache=False, eager attention (common.py:34-42, gpt2_ddp_training.py:24-27).
Effective batch 8 = world_size 2 x micro_batch 1 x accumulation_steps 4; 1024 tokens per step; per-rank inputs seeded with 31000+rank; model init seeded with 20261020.

DDP configuration: broadcast_buffers=False, bucket_cap_mb=25, gradient_as_bucket_view=True; the baseline already uses no_sync() for the first accumulation_steps-1 micro-batches. NCCL is the training process group (init_process_group at gpt2_ddp_training.py:52); a separate gloo control group is used only for barriers outside timing.

No external model weights or datasets: weights are seeded synthetic fixtures and token IDs are generated in-process, so assets is empty; the shared --assets argument (common.py:21) is unused by this entry.
